summary: The index is designed to reflect the price fluctuation and performance of 500 predominantly small-cap companies in the China A-Share market. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in component securities of the underlying index. It is non-diversified.
